suggestions.topic: Native AA implementation decision: Frames (EIP-8141) vs EIP-8130
suggestions.rationale: Decision explicitly deferred to ACDE #244 following AA breakout on Aug 25. L2 teams raised DoS/TPS concerns; static frames workstream proposed as resolution. This is a Hegota headliner decision with broad implementation impact.

suggestions.topic: Hegota headliner selection and CFI decisions
suggestions.rationale: EL client preference lists for Hegota PFIs are due by September 10 (ACDE #245). FOCIL confirmed as headliner; native AA is CFI pending implementation decision. Teams need to align on which PFIs move to CFI and establish implementation priorities.

Gloas fork activated on Platåberget on August 21 (Thursday 7:50 AM UTC). This call should confirm activation success, participation rates, and any blockers discovered post-activation before testnet graduation planning.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam testnet graduation timeline and remaining blockers
suggestions.rationale: devnet-8 (Platåberget) is the last devnet before mainnet. Multiple EIPs still pending promotion to Review/SFI status. Hive chain PR #1589 blocked on EIP-7928 disagreement. Teams need clear path to testnet launches (Sepolia/Hoodi).

suggestions.topic: History expiry window coordination for Hegota
suggestions.rationale: 200M gas limit at Hegota makes history expiry critical for 2TB node operators. Clients currently misaligned (6 months to 1 year). Async discussion deferred to ETH R&D channel, but synchronous decision needed before Hegota spec freeze.

suggestions.topic: EIP-7923 (Linear Memory Costing) spec update and max-memory report
suggestions.rationale: jochem committed to spec update and max-memory report in 2 weeks from ACDE #243 (due ~August 27). This is a PFI'd Hegota proposal replacing quadratic memory pricing with significant performance implications.

suggestions.topic: discv5-only mode implementation status for Glamsterdam
suggestions.rationale: discv5-only mode ready for devnet-8, but two clients still need flags to disable discv4 and no client has implemented ENR fields in admin_nodeInfo. Needed for full REST/SSZ migration and Glamsterdam mainnet readiness.
